name: Quinupramine
summary: Quinupramine (brand names Kevopril, Kinupril, Adeprim, Quinuprine) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) used in Europe for the treatment of depression.

pharmacology.text: Pharmacologically, quinupramine acts in vitro as a strong muscarinic acetylcholine receptor antagonist (anticholinergic) and H1 receptor antagonist (antihistamine), moderate 5-HT2 receptor antagonist, and weak serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor. It has negligible affinity for the α1-adrenergic, α2-adrenergic, β-adrenergic, or D2 receptor.

uses.text: Quinupramine (brand names Kevopril, Kinupril, Adeprim, Quinuprine) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) used in Europe for the treatment of depression.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, dizziness and drowsiness. Overdose is dangerous and can cause seizures and fatal heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 已知副作用包括口乾、便秘、視力模糊、頭暈和嗜睡。過量很危險，可能導致癲癇發作和致命的心律問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知副作用包括口干、便秘、视力模糊、头晕和嗜睡。过量很危险，可能导致癫痫发作和致命的心律问题。

fact.en: Quinupramine replaces the side chain of imipramine with a rigid quinuclidine cage, a three-dimensional bridged ring.
fact.zh: Quinupramine 把丙米嗪的側鏈換成堅硬的奎寧環籠，這是一個立體的橋環結構。
fact.zhHans: Quinupramine 把丙米嗪的侧链换成坚硬的奎宁环笼，这是一个立体的桥环结构。
